description: Monthly per-code affiliate commission report, newest month first: attributed paid revenue (USD cents) and what each creator is owed, from the affiliate payment ledger. A payment counts only within 12 months of that buyer's FIRST attributed payment on the code (the first-year deal), and commission is computed per payment at the % frozen when it landed, so later rate changes never rewrite history. Refunds are NOT netted here: deduct them by hand at payout, like referral rewards. Read-only; payouts are manual. Use set_coupon_affiliate to mark a code, list_coupons to see which codes carry an affiliate %.
name: affiliate_commissions
